en.headline: State funeral for Tung Chee-hwa scheduled for 20 September, sources say
en.dek: Hong Kong’s first chief executive is expected to receive a state funeral with the national flag draped on the casket; a central government funeral committee is preparing the arrangements.
body: A state funeral for the late Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong’s first chief executive and former vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference, is scheduled for 20 September, according to sources.

Sources said a funeral committee established by the central government is preparing the state-level proceedings. The coffin is expected to be draped with the national flag, and a senior CPPCC official is scheduled to attend the public memorial service in Hong Kong and deliver a eulogy. Top state leaders are expected to send floral wreaths.

Local authorities and central government offices in Hong Kong have begun preliminary preparations covering the schedule, venue, ceremonial logistics and security. The Hong Kong Jockey Club indicated that any formal changes to the September 20 race fixtures at Sha Tin would be announced in due course. Tung died on 8 September at the age of 89.

zh.headline: 消息：董建華國葬訂9月20日舉行
zh.dek: 香港首任行政長官、全國政協前副主席董建華的國葬據悉訂於9月20日舉行，靈柩將覆蓋國旗，中央成立治喪委員會安排事宜。
body: 據消息人士透露，已故香港首任行政長官、全國政協前副主席董建華的國葬訂於9月20日舉行。
消息指，中央已成立治喪委員會籌備國葬事宜。靈柩預料將覆蓋國旗，一名全國政協高級官員將出席在港舉行的公祭並致悼詞，國家領導人亦會送上花圈致哀。
本港當局及駐港中央機構已展開初步準備，包括日程、場地、儀式物流及保安安排。香港賽馬會表示，有關9月20日沙田賽事的任何正式改動將適時公布。董建華於9月8日辭世，享年89歲。
